Services at Branch 1

Everything your car needs, under one roof.

The same equipment and the same process we use on Range Rovers, applied to every make we work on.

Diagnostics & warning lights

Manufacturer-level fault finding, coding and software updates, with a written report before any repair.

Major & minor servicing

Factory-schedule servicing with the correct oil specification and genuine filters, logged in your service history.

Engine repair

Oil leaks, timing chains, turbos, cooling faults and full rebuilds on petrol and diesel engines.

Gearbox & transmission

Automatic, dual-clutch, PDK and CVT servicing, valve body and mechatronic repairs, and rebuilds.

Suspension, brakes & alignment

Air struts and compressors, Patrol HBMC, shocks and bushes, brakes and four-wheel alignment.

Air conditioning

Compressor, condenser and climate-control repairs that hold up in a Sharjah summer.

Electrical & electronics

Battery drain, wiring faults, modules, infotainment, cameras and parking sensors.

Body, paint & detailing

Accident repair, colour-matched paintwork, dent removal, polishing and ceramic coating.

Known faults, by make

The problems these cars are known for, fixed properly.

Most premium cars have a few well-known weak points. We diagnose them before quoting, so you pay for the actual fault and not a guess.

Mercedes-Benz

Airmatic air suspension leaks and compressor failure, 7G-Tronic conductor plate and 9G-Tronic gearbox faults, and engine oil leaks.

BMW

Oil filter housing and valve cover gasket leaks, electric water pump and thermostat failure, timing chain noise on four-cylinder diesels, and xDrive transfer case faults.

Audi & Volkswagen

DSG and S tronic mechatronic faults, timing chain tensioner wear on TFSI engines, and oil consumption checks.

Porsche

PDK gearbox servicing, coolant pipe leaks on V8 Cayennes, and air suspension faults.

Toyota & Lexus

Major services on Land Cruiser, Prado and LX, front suspension and brake wear from desert driving, and AC performance.

Nissan & Infiniti

Patrol and QX80 hydraulic body motion control (HBMC) suspension faults, V8 servicing and brake wear.

Chevrolet, GMC & Cadillac

V8 lifter and active fuel management faults, 8 and 10-speed gearbox shudder, and Magnetic Ride suspension.

Ford & Jeep

10-speed gearbox servicing, EcoBoost cam phaser rattle, and Grand Cherokee Quadra-Lift air suspension.

Good to know

Branch 1: questions owners ask

Where is Al Rahal Branch 1?

Branch 1 is at the same address as Al Rahal Auto Maintenance: Jabel Tarek Street, directly opposite Sharjah Cricket Stadium, Sharjah. Open Saturday to Thursday, 8:00 AM to 1:00 PM and 4:00 PM to 9:00 PM. Closed Friday.

Which cars does Branch 1 service?

German, Japanese, American, European and luxury cars, including Mercedes-Benz, BMW, Audi, Porsche, Volkswagen, Toyota, Lexus, Nissan, Infiniti, Chevrolet, GMC, Cadillac, Ford, Jeep, Jaguar, Volvo, Bentley and Rolls-Royce.

Do you service Toyota Land Cruiser, Lexus LX and Nissan Patrol?

Yes. Branch 1 handles major and minor services, suspension (including the Patrol's hydraulic HBMC system), brakes, air conditioning and diagnostics on Land Cruiser, Prado, LX, Patrol and QX80.

Can you service my car while it is under the manufacturer warranty?

Yes. Routine servicing at a qualified independent workshop that follows the manufacturer schedule and uses genuine parts keeps the warranty valid. Recalls and warranty repairs are still done by the main dealer.

Is Branch 1 cheaper than the main dealer?

Our labour rates are lower than main-dealer rates, and you receive a fixed price on WhatsApp before any work starts, so there are no surprises on the invoice.

Are Range Rover and Land Rover serviced at Branch 1?

Range Rover and Land Rover stay with our main Al Rahal workshop at the same address. Branch 1 is dedicated to all other makes.

How do I book at Branch 1?

Tap any Book on WhatsApp button, choose your make and the service, and send. An expert replies with a fixed price and the next available slot. You can also call 055 747 9292.

Do you offer collection and delivery?

Yes, across Sharjah, Dubai and Ajman. Ask on WhatsApp when you book.
